EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

KING (he) "I have had enough of this drab, medieval aesthetic. It's time for a change. I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic...of all time."

ADVISOR 1 (he) "But, your majesty, we are in the 14th century. We can't just...vaporwave...our entire empire."

KING (he) "Nonsense. I have a vision. I want our kingdom to be a utopia of...synthwave...and...retro-futurism."

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, who are all looking on in confusion.

KING (he) "I want our flags to be replaced with...neon-lit...slogans. Our coats of arms to be replaced with...glitchy... graphics. And our architecture to be replaced with...surreal...dreamscapes."

ADVISOR 2 (he) "But, your majesty, this is madness. We can't just...disrupt...the entire fabric of our society."

KING (he) "I don't care. I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic...of all time. And I want it now."

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's advisors are seen implementing the king's vision. They are painting the walls with...neon-lit...slogans, and replacing the flags with...glitchy...graphics.

KING (he) walks through the streets, looking on in satisfaction.

KING (he) "Ah, yes. This is more like it. Our kingdom is now the most...futuristic...of all time."

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his advisors.

KING (he) "I want our kingdom to be a utopia of...synthwave...and...retro-futurism. I want our people to be happy and...content."

ADVISOR 3 (he) "But, your majesty, this is all a bit...much. Don't you think?"

KING (he) "No, I don't think. I know. And I will do whatever it takes to make our kingdom the most...futuristic...of all time."

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike place. The buildings are shaped like...surreal... sculptures, and the streets are filled with...neon-lit...slogans.

KING (he) walks through the streets, looking on in satisfaction.

KING (he) "Ah, yes. This is it. Our kingdom is now the most...futuristic...of all time."

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
